blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu – The Mandaue City government will not hold a grand Christmas party for its employees this year, opting instead for simple celebrations in their respective offices as the city continues to observe austerity measures. Mayor Thadeo “Jonkie” Ouano said each office would receive a small allocation for food to allow employees to hold modest Christmas gatherings, similar to last year. In 2025, the city also skipped a grand Christmas party for its entire workforce, particularly in the aftermath of Typhoon Tino. Instead, individual offices were allowed to hold simple celebrations.
